Independent game studio

Small games, made with care.

Mekax Studio makes calm puzzle and quick arcade games for iPhone: easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and fair to play.

Our games

Block puzzle

Block Streak

Fill rows, columns and 3x3 squares, chain your clears and keep the streak alive.

Sorting puzzle

Color Sort

Pour colored liquids between tubes and bring a faded coral reef back to life.

Logic puzzle

Line Dots

Connect every pair of glowing dots and fill the whole board. New puzzles every day.

Arcade

Dunk Wings

Tap to fly a winged ball through the hoops. Swish in a row and set it on fire.

Logic puzzle

Meow Arrows

Untangle the yarn arrows in the right order and rescue the cats caught in them.

Timing challenge

StopTimer

Tap to start the clock, tap again to stop it right on the target. 300 levels, a daily challenge and a 2-player duel.

Maze puzzle

Farm Mow

Swipe your mower through a farm maze and mow every patch of grass.
